regions.today: Cloud thickens later this evening, bringing the odd spot of light rain or drizzle. Becoming breezy also with moderate to fresh southerly winds developing.
regions.tonight: Starting off largely dry tonight, but a spell of rain will develop overnight with clearer conditions following by dawn. Lowest temperatures of 10 to 14 degrees, with moderate to fresh southwesterly winds, veering westerly.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow will be a breezy day with sunny spells and scattered blustery showers. The showers will become isolated through the afternoon, with a dry evening. Moderate to fresh westerly winds, easing in the evening. Highs of 15 or 16 degrees.
